description: This Python script implements a test server supporting HTTP, TCP proxy, WebSocket, and basic auth proxy functionalities for Chrome testing, including server configuration, request handling, and server startup logic.

classes.name: WebSocketOptions
classes.description: Holds configuration options for the WebSocket server, including host, port, security, and authentication settings.

classes.name: ThreadingHTTPServer
classes.description: A specialized HTTP server class that supports threading and client verification.

classes.name: TestPageHandler
classes.description: Handles HTTP requests for testing, providing default responses and handling CONNECT requests.

classes.name: ProxyRequestHandler
classes.description: Implements an HTTP proxy server supporting CONNECT, GET, and HEAD methods.

classes.name: BasicAuthProxyRequestHandler
classes.description: A proxy handler that enforces basic authentication.

classes.name: ServerRunner
classes.description: Manages server configuration, creation, and startup for different server types (WebSocket, proxy, auth proxy).

methods.name: DefaultResponseHandler
methods.description: Handles default HTTP responses for unhandled paths.

methods.name: DefaultConnectResponseHandler
methods.description: Handles default responses for malformed or illegal CONNECT requests.

methods.name: _start_read_write
methods.description: Facilitates bidirectional data transfer between client and server sockets.

methods.name: do_CONNECT
methods.description: Handles HTTP CONNECT method to establish a TCP tunnel.

methods.name: parse_request
methods.description: Overrides request parsing to include proxy authentication.

methods.name: __make_data_dir
methods.description: Creates or retrieves the data directory for server files.

methods.name: create_server
methods.description: Initializes and starts the appropriate server based on configuration.

methods.name: add_options
methods.description: Adds command-line options for server configuration.
